newsitem.title: UK: N. Electric up in firm sector on bid report.
newsitem.headline: N. Electric up in firm sector on bid report.

text.p: Shares in Northern Electric gained more than two percent on Friday, lifted by cross-sector buying and a report that U.S. power company CalEnergy is set to raise its offer for the British group, traders said.
Northern Electric shares touched an intraday high of 618p before settling back to 613p, up 12p on the day by 1245 GMT. Other stocks in the sector were firm. The broader market was up 0.7 percent.
The Evening Standard reported that CalEnergy was poised to raise its offer to around 660p per share from the present 630p and it was said to have contacted Northern Electric.

But market sources said they were sceptical about the report, noting that the 660p offer would be at a high premium to the current share price and that CalEnergy has already bought just over 29 percent of Northern Electric at 630p.
Also, they said the market was waiting for Northern Electric to present a defence to the bid which could include strong interim results, possibly early next week.
CalEnergy would be expected to wait for that defence before raising any bid, they said.
